thesis: The morning pullback long (hold of 76-78, stop 74.9) has failed: intraday last 74.36 (-4.5% vs 77.88) is below the 74.9 invalidation and the SMA20 (77.13), after lower closes from the 90.87 high (5-day return -11.9%), and the technical card now rates the setup none with no fresh catalyst on the news card. The bear won the debate on timing and stop discipline, and the bull conceded Underweight. The long-term structure (74.36 > SMA50 66.81 > SMA200 36.98), net cash and about 39% YoY revenue growth argue against a Sell, so this is a stop-discipline downgrade: no new position, and any position opened this morning should be cut back if the close confirms the break.
invalidation: The downgrade is wrong if CDNA holds today's 73.39 low and reclaims the SMA20 (77.13) on rising volume, which would re-open a pullback long toward 90.87 against the 65.4 structural stop.
key_risks: Morning stop 74.9 replaced by the technical card's structural stop 65.4 (below the 65.89 20-day low, about 1.7 ATR): 74.9 is breached and a stop under 73.39 would be only about 0.2 ATR away; 65.4/90.87 are reference levels for a conditional re-entry, not a live buy (R/R from 74.36 about 1.8)
The intraday last is about 15 min delayed and the close is not final; a late recovery above 74.9 would leave the morning invalidation untriggered
Beta 2.49, ATR 5.17 (about 7%) and short interest 13.9% of float: a squeeze back above 77 could make the downgrade a whipsaw
Gap-fill risk toward the 65.89 20-day low if the post-earnings fade continues (bear downside case, probability 0.35)
Growth is decelerating (YoY about 52% to 39.3%, QoQ 12.1% to 5.6%) with forward P/E about 47.5 and EV/EBITDA 151 in a risk-off tape with ^TNX at 5.141
